faults.what: Narration tells the story of Arjun explaining the vyuh to Subhadra who falls asleep, but the visuals show Abhimanyu lifting and fighting with the chariot wheel until 0:46.
faults.fix: Move the chariot wheel battle footage earlier to match lines 5 and 6 (0:27-0:36), and place the scene of Arjun and pregnant Subhadra here at 0:37-0:46.

faults.what: Visual shows Arjun talking to a sleeping Subhadra while narration discusses Mahabharata's Drona Parva and Abhimanyu's quote about his father teaching him to enter but not exit.
faults.fix: Realign the Arjun/Subhadra visual to play during line 7 (0:37-0:46) and show scriptural/textual reference or Abhimanyu reflecting during line 8.

faults.what: Narration says 'Tab usne rath ka pahiya hi utha liya' while on screen Abhimanyu is still riding an intact chariot with bow and arrow.
faults.fix: Cut directly to the broken chariot and wheel pickup when this line is spoken.

faults.what: AI warping on the chariot wheel spokes and Abhimanyu's fingers clipping through the wooden rim as he holds it.
faults.fix: Regenerate or clean up the wheel grip frame to prevent shifting spokes and clipping hands.

strongest: The opening visual and narration hook establishing the massive Chakravyuh formation against a lone warrior immediately commands attention.
weakest: The complete narrative desync from 0:37 to 0:54 where the Subhadra story visuals are delayed by an entire scene while battle footage continues under unrelated narration.
